name: rootmind
description: Search and read your own files on this computer (the local folders RootMind indexes).
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to [RootMind](https://github.com/cgaeking/rootmind), a local document search for Windows and Linux. Claude gets RootMind's read-only tools: full-text and fuzzy search, a document list, reading a document or a part of it, and statistics. Answers can cite the page, slide or sheet.

Requires RootMind 2.0 or later, installed from https://github.com/cgaeking/rootmind/releases/latest, with **Serve MCP over HTTP** turned on (RootMind → Settings → RootMind service; on by default; on Linux, start RootMind once so it sets up its service). The bundle needs no configuration: it finds the RootMind service on this computer and connects to it on 127.0.0.1 with the service's token. Your documents stay on your computer; only what Claude reads through the tools goes into the conversation.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search your own files on this computer: fast full-text search over the local folders RootMind indexes, with snippets and the page, slide or sheet of each hit.

tools.name: search_fuzzy
tools.description: Typo-tolerant search for when search_documents finds nothing or a term may be misspelled.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List indexed documents with metadata, optionally filtered by file type or name.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read the text of a document, or a character window of it.

tools.name: get_statistics
tools.description: Statistics about the document collection: number of documents, file types, total size.
